required.name: Certificate III (or higher) in Boilermaking/Heavy Fabrication
required.hint: Certificate III/Cert III/Cert 3 in Engineering (Boilermaker/Heavy Fabrication)

required.name: Minimum 2 years relevant post-trade boilermaker/fabrication experience
Site readiness: Standard 11 OR White Card (either acceptable)

positives.name: Queensland coal-mining/site experience
positives.hint: QLD mining sites: Goonyella, Blackwater, Moranbah, etc.

positives.name: Stackers, reclaimers, shiploaders, or port infrastructure
Work with reputable mining contractors
positives.hint: Kaefer, Monadelphous, Richglen, CQ Field, FMS Group

red_flags.name: Candidate explicitly located outside Australia
red_flags.hint: If location text clearly outside AU → red flag. If missing/unclear → mark Unknown.

notes.unknown_policy: If evidence for a required item is unclear or not explicit, mark as Unknown (do not guess). If > max_unknown_required, prefer 'Unsure – Needs Manual Review'.
notes.site_ready_tip: Mark 'site_ready' as met if EITHER Standard 11 OR White Card appears. If neither is clearly stated, set Unknown.
